items.item: C12 all NMR and four liquid-film IR records
items.evidence: NMR: butanone, butanal, 2-methylpropanal, ethanoic acid, methyl methanoate, 2-chloropropane, 1-chloropropane, ethyl propanoate and the A2 rivals pentanoic acid, methyl butanoate and propyl ethanoate. Liquid-film IR: butanone, ethanoic acid, methyl methanoate and ethyl propanoate. Every exact shift, phase-specific band and applicable proton field/solvent remains held; no gas trace substituted.

The [NIST MS 61712 public plot](https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?Index=0&Large=on&Spec=C563804&Type=Mass), independently inspected, verifies 3-methylbutan-2-one base peak m/z 43 (100%) and molecular ion 86 (approximately 21%, plot-read). These MS facts are verified; no exact raw-height table is claimed. Pentan-3-ol, 2-methylbutan-2-ol and 2,2-dimethylpropanoic acid still need requested NMR and liquid-film IR records. The ketone liquid band near 1715, its own proton/carbon shifts and the pentanoic acid/pentan-2-one rival shifts remain unverified. G03 IR/NMR recording hold remains.

The [Western Carolina University Chem 132 procedure, printed p3](https://www2.chem21labs.com/labfiles/westerncarolina_gl132lab03_procedure.pdf) specifies 0.1 M CaCl2, a nichrome wire loop, a thin solution film and brief placement at the top of the blue cone to observe colour. The [RSC procedure](https://edu.rsc.org/experiments/flame-tests-the-wooden-splint-method/759.article) identifies calcium as brick-red. Together these verify documented use of the requested concentration and loop method, not guaranteed visibility on every bench. Use a clean loop and the documented flame conditions; no concentration change is inferred.

items.item: C04 graphite furnace and 0.005 mg/L lead
items.evidence: [EPA Method 200.9](https://www.epa.gov/sites/default/files/2015-08/documents/method_200-9_rev_2-2_1994.pdf), sections 2 and 6.1.1 and Tables 2/3: programmed heating of a graphite tube, lead atomisation about 2000 C; typical MDL 0.7 micrograms/L; Table 3 includes a 5.0 micrograms/L fortification with 1.9% RSD. This supports the heated-tube description and measurement at 0.005 mg/L, without confusing detection and quantification limits.

A primary DPHE laboratory analysis reproduced in the [World Bank PRIDE environmental assessment, Table 4-9](https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/639201582839586063/pdf/Revised-Environmental-and-Social-Impact-Assessment-Bangladesh-Private-Investment-amp-Digital-Entrepreneurship-Project-P170688.pdf) gives lead, AAS, LOQ 0.001 mg/L. This establishes feasibility, not a universal limit for every AAS system. The question correctly provides a validated method-specific limit.

For a NSW school, use: "seek advice from the local public health unit and the school facilities manager, and ask the water supplier to check the incoming supply". [NSW Health](https://www.health.nsw.gov.au/environment/water/Pages/Drinking-Water-and-Public-Health.aspx) identifies public health units for health advice and suppliers for supply issues. A supplier can advise, but does not own all internal school plumbing. This is the requested contact clarification, not a new calculation error.

[DPI July 2023 submission, printed p4](https://www.chiefscientist.nsw.gov.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0013/1606/DPI-Fisheries-Submission-to-Independent-Review-into-Menindee-Fish-Deaths-2023.pdf) says the largest reported events were observed at first light. The new wording attributes the observation to fisheries reports and does not assert a measured all-night series.

No learner conclusion relies on an alkene staying orange. Attempt 1 uses hexane. The reaction paragraph explicitly allows an alkene to turn dichromate green, and feedback 2 conditions alcohol support on bromine staying orange. P05 keeps C out of that demonstration. Source: exact Revision 2 narration, Visual paragraphs, attempts and tables in `../lessons/chem-m8-c08.md` and `chem-m8-p05.md`.

[CDC tetanus chapter](https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/252999/cdc_252999_DS1.pdf) describes infectious tetanus acquired through contaminated wounds, with soil as a reservoir and no person-to-person contagion. "Tetanus comes from soil" is a fair short counterexample.

Use: "The dividing criterion is whether a pathogen causes the disease. Many infectious diseases pass between people; tetanus does not." Exact standing text rechecked in the read-only L06 HTML. Added to `../site-corrections-m8.md`. [CDC](https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/252999/cdc_252999_DS1.pdf). Owner cultural finding 5 is unchanged.

[AIHW release](https://www.aihw.gov.au/news-media/media-releases/2026/july/daily-smoking-rates-have-fallen-over-the-past-20-years): first results of the 2025 National Drug Strategy Household Survey; more than 17,500 participants aged 14+, June to December 2025; daily smoking 5.6% at 14+. [Ministerial release](https://www.health.gov.au/ministers/the-hon-mark-butler-mp/media/australias-smoking-rates-declining?language=en) gives 5.8% at 18+, so "about six in a hundred Australian adults" fits the adult figure.

items.item: B08 heavy periods and gut bleeding
items.evidence: [NHLBI iron-deficiency anaemia](https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/anemia/iron-deficiency-anemia) names heavy menstrual periods and gastrointestinal bleeding. Both new examples are supported.

[Cancer Australia melanoma statistics](https://www.canceraustralia.gov.au/cancer-types/melanoma-skin/melanoma-skin-statistics), updated 18 December 2025 and explicitly sourced to AIHW Cancer Data in Australia 2025, prints 17,443 estimated new cases in 2025: 10,187 males plus 7,256 females. It also gives 94% five-year relative survival for 2017 to 2021. The exact count and rounded 17,400 tag are supported when labelled as the 2025 estimate. Relative survival is not an individual cure chance.

It also gives 94% five-year relative survival for 2017 to 2021. The exact count and rounded 17,400 tag are supported when labelled as the 2025 estimate. Relative survival is not an individual cure chance.

[AIHW Australia's health 2024](https://healthcarefunding.specialcommission.nsw.gov.au/assets/Uploads/publications/Exhibit-M/Exhibit-M_TAB_M.015_SCI.0011.0498.0001.pdf) gives diagnosed diabetes prevalence 5.1% in 2021, all types excluding gestational. Keep that year and definition if quoting it. The 5.5% city example is explicitly teaching data; it is not a national estimate.

[AIHW cancer overview](https://www.aihw.gov.au/reports/australias-health/cancer) supports higher incidence at older ages. The Revision 2 grey tag and rising age-band shape print no age-specific numbers. No invented precise bar heights were approved.

[Doll and Hill 1950 opening paragraph](https://csts.ua.edu/files/2019/01/1950-09-30-BMJ-Smoking-Carcinoma-of-the-Lung-Doll-Hill.pdf) gives England and Wales 612 and 9,287; 9287/612 = 15.1748. "About fifteen times" is correct.

A single claimed 1980 to 1982 peak for both incidence and mortality is not established. [Cancer Australia mortality](https://ncci.canceraustralia.gov.au/node/559) identifies male mortality 1981. [AIHW incidence Table D3.2](https://www.aihw.gov.au/getmedia/60a20708-55e4-4dc0-a9c4-d5430c096b6c/12466.pdf?inline=true) starts in 1982 and shows 85.1 in 1982 and 85.3 in 1984 on the 2001 standard. The spoken overall decline since the early 1980s is supported; do not invent one exact shared peak year.

[Doll and Hill 1950 Table V](https://www.bmj.com/content/bmj/2/4682/739.full.pdf): male smokers consuming at least 25 cigarette-equivalents/day, most recent amount before illness: cases 136 + 32 = 168/647 (26.0%); controls 71 + 13 = 84/622 (13.5%). Draw two bars labelled "male smokers, 25+ cigarette-equivalents/day". If using all 649 male patients per group, recalculate to 25.9% and 12.9% and change the denominator label.

[Lean et al. 2024](https://doi.org/10.1016/S2213-8587%2823%2900385-6): 11/85 (13%) of extension participants with data were in remission at five years. "Followed with continued support" is appropriate. It is not 13% of every originally randomised participant.

[Lean et al. 2019 primary report](https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/180894/) gives 53/149 (36%) in the original intervention group at two years. Keep the different denominator from the five-year extension explicit on the chart, as Revision 2 does.

[Cancer Australia, AIHW-based incidence series](https://ncci.canceraustralia.gov.au/diagnosis/cancer-incidence/cancer-incidence): age 20 to 29 fell from 16.8/100,000 in 1999 to 7.6 projected in 2024. This supports "young adults ... since the late 1990s". It does not establish that date for a pooled 0 to 39 group; the newer AIHW commentary uses 2005 for that pooled group.

[Vanos et al. 2017](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/php.12721) used personal wrist dosimeters in a schoolyard shade comparison. A wearable UV measurement is a fair method to name in a teaching case. The card's 40% is teaching data, not this paper's result.

[Archibald et al., original 12,000-test study](https://www.geneticclinic.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2017-prepair-Genet-Med-1.pdf), abstract: 610/12000 = 5.08%, 342 CF, 35 fragile X, 241 SMA, with eight carrying two conditions. This is the three-condition program, not Mackenzie's Mission. The already logged Mackenzie correction stands; no duplicate entry added.
